contract: Road user a has turned "so as to proceed in the opposite direction" through region r, "whether accomplished by one continuous movement or not", recognized as it leaves r. The act begins at the observation at which a's footprint came to overlap r (rel.occupies), having not overlapped it at the previous observation: its entry into r. The act is recognized at the observation at which a's footprint does not overlap r, having overlapped it at the previous observation: its exit from r. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until a has entered r again and left it. At that observation the magnitude of the heading change of a since its entry into r, in degrees and positive to the left, integrated from its yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) with no interval between consecutive observations longer than step, lies in the band from u_turn_min to a full turn minus u_turn_min, both inclusive, so that a turn short of a reversal and a full loop both lie outside it; a reversal to either hand is denoted, and one made in several movements, with halts or backing between them inside r, is denoted where its integrated heading change lies in the band. Conduct before the entry is not read. It denotes the change of a's heading between its entry into r and its exit only: it says nothing of the lanes a uses, of its speed, of its class, or of why it turns. Not denoted: a passage through r whose heading change magnitude is below u_turn_min, such as a turn to the left or the right or a passage straight through; a heading change magnitude above a full turn minus u_turn_min, which is a loop; an observation at which a is still in r. Where the entry was not observed (it lies before the recording, or a's overlap with r was unknown at an observation since), where an interval between consecutive observations since the observation before the entry is longer than step, or where a yaw rate since the entry is missing, it is unknown.

params.name: step
params.meaning: the largest interval between consecutive observations across which the heading change is integrated: the sampling standard of the integration, not a window and not a bound on how long ago the entry lies

params.name: u_turn_min
params.meaning: the smallest heading change magnitude at which the passage counts as a reversal of direction: the tolerance within which an observed sampled heading counts as opposite

act.onset: The act begins at the observation at which a's footprint came to overlap r (rel.occupies), having not overlapped it at the previous observation: its entry into r.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which a's footprint does not overlap r, having overlapped it at the previous observation: its exit from r.
act.extent: The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until a has entered r again and left it.
act.history: Conduct before the entry is not read.

elements.span: a's footprint came to overlap r (rel.occupies)
elements.justification: rel.occupies: "a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region" — its rise marks the entry into r and its fall the exit; it is footprint overlap, not distance.

kin.yaw_rate: "rate of change of heading, positive when the heading turns to the left (counter-clockwise)"; integrated by headingSince from the entry, it gives the reversal "so as to proceed in the opposite direction" whether made in one movement or not. Not a stand-in for road curvature: the road user's own turning is read.

residues.span: the turning of a vehicle upon a highway
residues.why: the class of the road user and the way it turns on are not part of the motion; the caller states the class of a and binds r on the way the words name

literals.why: a full turn of the heading: the upper end of the band is a full turn minus u_turn_min, so that a loop is told apart from a reversal

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: Region r is a roundabout region. Road user a enters r heading east, circulates counter-clockwise and leaves r heading west, its yaw rate observed at every scene at the sampling standard: the magnitude of its heading change since the entry is a half turn, inside the band, so the concept holds at the exit.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: Same region; a enters heading east and leaves heading north after a quarter turn to the left: the magnitude of its heading change is below u_turn_min, so the concept does not hold at the exit.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in holds, but a's yaw rate is missing at the scenes inside r: the heading change since the entry is unknown, and so is the concept at the exit.
